scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../admin && npx vite build --base=/admin/
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
